title: Kavach combined-receipts row
description: One entry in kavach-data/history/triage-results/<timestamp>/combined-receipts.json — the deterministic handoff contract from kavach-diagnose to kavach-imaintain. Mirrors the actual output shape of validate_replay_receipts.py; this schema is the reference, that script is the source of truth for runtime behavior.

groupId.description: Shared root-cause grouping key (same exception type + normalized step pattern), or null for an ungrouped singleton.

verdict.description: Machine-format verdict, post-validation (may differ from originalVerdict if a gate check downgraded it).

originalVerdict.description: The verdict the diagnosing worker originally claimed, before validate_receipt()'s gate checks.

reportVerdict.description: Human-readable label for the verdict report table, e.g. 'Script Issue — Fix Proposed'.

analysisTier.description: Whether this row's evidence came from an actual live browser (tier2_live_replay) or a cheaper static/cached tier. kavach-imaintain's own verification (Maven, LocatorProbe) is independent of this and required regardless.

evidence.description: Concrete observed evidence (DOM excerpts, count()/evaluate() outputs, error text) — required non-empty for confirmed_product_bug, suspected_product_bug, and not_reproduced_passed_live.

recommendedAction.description: Free-text description of the proposed fix. There is no structured fixSuggestion object on a kavach receipt by design — kavach-imaintain derives targetFile/targetLine/the concrete patch from this text plus the matching fix-pattern file, never from recommendedAction text alone without a pattern-file match.

scenarioCount.description: Number of individual scenarios this row's groupId covers.

distinctIssueCount.description: Number of distinct root causes folded into this groupId (>1 when scenarios sharing a groupId turned out to fail for different reasons, e.g. differing Examples-table data).

domStructureChecked.description: Required, non-placeholder (must contain a real DOM excerpt or count()/evaluate() output, not just 'true'/'checked') when verdict is confirmed_product_bug.

staleLocatorRuledOut.description: Required, non-placeholder, same rule as domStructureChecked, when verdict is confirmed_product_bug.
